scope.research_question: Implement the bounded 2026-10-08 efficiency findings within this skill owner for RhapsodIA 0.8.0.

sources.title: RhapsodIA token and latency research, 2026-10-08
sources.notes: Frozen bounded research; source/vendor numbers are not project benchmark results.

findings.statement: Task context packs and stable prompt prefixes: required refs cannot be omitted; bounded UTF-8; verify content pins; deterministic prefix
findings.rationale: Outside this skill owner; accounted in the companion skill trace and coordinated release map.

findings.statement: Evidence and artifact reference indexes: stale/tampered/foreign scope never qualifies; source owner remains explicit
findings.rationale: Outside this skill owner; accounted in the companion skill trace and coordinated release map.

findings.statement: Deterministic action-result reference cache: input closure, command, environment, toolchain, policy and output changes miss; fresh/independent gates bypass cache
findings.rationale: Outside this skill owner; accounted in the companion skill trace and coordinated release map.

findings.statement: Portable usage, telemetry and paired comparison: unknown metrics stay null; no prompt/log/secret collection; confounds rejected; no speedup claim from bytes
findings.rationale: Outside this skill owner; accounted in the companion skill trace and coordinated release map.

findings.statement: Cost-aware delegation and selective retrieval: one canonical writer; no fanout with unknown estimates/dependencies; mandatory verifier never removed
findings.rationale: Outside this skill owner; accounted in the companion skill trace and coordinated release map.

findings.statement: Runtime capabilities and typed failure observations: resolution never executes; validity bound to tool/source/TTL; transient failures expire
findings.rationale: Receipt/tool-pinned capabilities and expiring typed discovery outcomes

findings.statement: Incremental runtime handoffs: exact-parent acknowledgement, round-trip identity, bounded chain, full fallback; v1 preserved
findings.rationale: Exact-parent acknowledged transport with immutable reconstruction and full fallback

findings.statement: Negotiated modern stdio MCP profile: 2025 profile unchanged; explicit 2026 stateless profile uses verified spec; no write tool
findings.rationale: Modern per-request read-only stdio profile alongside unchanged legacy behavior

findings.statement: Optional graph projections and safe cross-workspace reference exchange: no graph dependency; explicit export/import; no local paths or authority transfer
findings.rationale: Optional data-only observed capability relations with existing graph-patch contract

findings.statement: Cooperative leases and bounded discovery strategy statistics: TTL, token and generation checks; no stale lock stealing, no new execution authority
Agent integration, migration, synchronized full release: catalog/manifests/installers/regression tests; no loss of existing 52 skills or Local Graph v3
findings.rationale: Idempotent opt-in host guidance and cache ignore rule without hidden hooks
